name: symbol-navigator
description: AST-based symbol definition, pattern search, and heuristic references (Go + Python) for naitv-mcp agents.
author: madicen

entries.name: prefer-symbol-navigator
entries.body: After orienting with structural-anchor (or when you already know the repo layout), use symbol-navigator for precise “where is X defined?” and “where is X used?” — find_symbol_definition, search_by_pattern, get_symbol_references — instead of blind grep. References are heuristic (not gopls); treat matches as hints.

entries.name: find_symbol_definition
entries.body: Find the best AST definition for symbol under root_path (Go + Python). Uses cached symbol index under ~/.cache/naitv-mcp/symbol-navigator/.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to the project root","required":true},{"name":"depth","description":"Max directory walk depth (default 3)","required":false},{"name":"skip_dirs","description":"Directory basenames to prune","required":false},{"name":"symbol","description":"Symbol name to resolve","required":true},{"name":"kind","description":"Optional kind filter (function, method, class, type, etc.)","required":false}]

entries.name: search_by_pattern
entries.body: Search indexed symbol names with a regex pattern under root_path. Shares cache with find_symbol_definition.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to the project root","required":true},{"name":"depth","description":"Max directory walk depth (default 3)","required":false},{"name":"skip_dirs","description":"Directory basenames to prune","required":false},{"name":"pattern","description":"Regex matched against symbol names","required":true},{"name":"kind","description":"Optional kind filter","required":false}]

entries.name: get_symbol_references
entries.body: Heuristic reference scan for symbol (Go + Python). Always returns heuristic: true — not a replacement for gopls. Optional file_path scopes search to that file's directory first.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to the project root","required":true},{"name":"depth","description":"Max directory walk depth (default 3)","required":false},{"name":"skip_dirs","description":"Directory basenames to prune","required":false},{"name":"symbol","description":"Symbol name to find uses of","required":true},{"name":"file_path","description":"Optional path hint to prefer the definition's package/directory first","required":false}]
